fields.key_provisions: House-amended PN 3724 proposes computer-data-center incentive certification and retention conditions: a community-protection plan, project-footprint reporting and specified NDA certification. The plan and NDA conditions exclude centers below 10 MW peak demand. Separate exceptions concern specified pre-construction engagement requirements where construction began earlier, and NDA certification for previously certified owners/operators or qualified tenants. This is not a general amendment banning every data-center NDA under the Right-to-Know Law.

fields.key_provisions: Senate-amended PN 3727 would let a municipality adopt a public-meeting resolution pausing acceptance of new data-center land-development applications for up to 180 days, retroactive to specified public notice. Earlier applications are exempt and continue under the applicable earlier rules; submissions during a pause are deemed received the following day after it ends. Repeat use is barred for 18 months following formal expiration or repeal. This is optional local authority, not a statewide pause.

fields.key_provisions: Re-reported PN 2007 proposes a Data Center Transparency Act covering defined predominantly server-use facilities with peak electric demand of at least 10 MW. It combines specified public-agency NDA limits, at least two local public meetings and utility-application documentation before approval, restrictions on defined foreign-entity-controlled facilities, and energy/water-report certifications. Its proposed chapters have separate 180-day, immediate and 60-day commencement clauses; none supplies an enacted date here.
